It provides all the information generated in the production process ( supervision, quality control, production control, data storage, etc.) and allows its management and intervention.

The SCADA system has the following objectives:
- Provide sufficient information in a timely and reliable manner to achieve a safer and more efficient operation, in real time, of EGPR's power plants and of the electrical network close to them.
- Provide a set of network analysis tools that help the Dispatcher in making operational decisions.
- Deliver historical information that allows the analysis and preparation of reports at the internal and external levels, both corporate and regulatory entities.

- Comply with legal requirements established by the regulatory body and complying with regulatory requirements.

name: AI 4 Vegetation-Microsoft
short_description:
The aim of the PoC is to develop, in collaboration with Microsoft, artificial intelligence (AI) technologies that will enable the detection of selected tree species using high-resolution and, if necessary, multi-spectral satellite imagery. The PoC will be based on algorithms capable of
1) Identify rare species, species in danger of extinction or species of particular importance for the conservation of biodiversity in the area under consideration.
2) Detect the desired vegetation, the area where the vegetation species is present and/or the number of trees with a good level of confidence.
3) Applicable on a global scale.
4) Map of the area where the species has been found.
5) Index of the probability of the presence of the indicated species. 
6) Excel file with the location and name of the identified species
7) Report including at least location of species, GPS coordinates, species type, probability of correct identification/accuracy
8) Details of the methodology used to carry out the analysis, including references to the relevant bibliography.

name: APACHE GUACAMOLE REMOTE SERVICE BRAZIL
short_description:
OT SCADA Systems environment remote desktop gateway that provides users with the ability to access their desktop environments and applications from anywhere using just a web browser. It offers a unique solution for organizations and individuals seeking secure and convenient remote access to their systems without the need for installing additional client software.

Key Features:

Web-Based Interface: Guacamole's primary interface is a web application, allowing users to connect to their remote systems using a standard web browser. This eliminates the need to install dedicated software on the local device.

Protocol Agnostic: Guacamole supports a wide range of remote desktop protocols, such as RDP (Remote Desktop Protocol), VNC (Virtual Network Computing), SSH (Secure Shell), and Telnet. This flexibility allows users to connect to various types of systems, regardless of the underlying protocol.

Clientless Access: One of the standout features of Guacamole is that it's clientless. Users don't need to install any software or plugins on their devices. All they require is a web browser, making it easy to connect from different devices and operating systems.

Secure Connection: Guacamole supports encryption and authentication for connections, ensuring that remote access is secure. It also offers the ability to use SSL/TLS certificates for additional security.

Multi-User Support: Organizations can set up Guacamole for multiple users, each with their own authentication credentials and access rights. This is particularly useful for businesses that need to provide remote access to employees, contractors, or clients.

Centralized Management: Guacamole provides administrators with a web-based management interface to configure connections, manage users, and monitor activity. This centralized control simplifies the management of remote access infrastructure.

Customization and Extensibility: Guacamole can be customized to match an organization's branding and requirements. Additionally, it supports extensions and plugins that allow developers to enhance its functionality.

Session Recording and Playback: Some versions of Guacamole offer the ability to record user sessions, which can be useful for auditing, troubleshooting, and training purposes.

Components:

Guacamole Server: This is the core component responsible for managing and brokering connections between users and remote systems. It supports various protocols and handles the encoding and decoding of remote desktop data.

Guacamole Client: The web-based interface that users interact with. It allows users to log in, configure connections, and initiate remote sessions.

Database: Guacamole stores connection configurations, user accounts, and other relevant data in a relational database. MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Apache Derby are among the supported databases.

name: APP_NAS
short_description:
Application that manage Warnings, Notes and Substitutions to quickly alert of incidents occurring in the electrical system of Enel_DX.
This application makes use of tables (Sharepoint lists) and connects to the corporate email and Whatsapp to send information.
It has for functionality, manage and correct operational and data update abnormalities in field and technical systems.

Warning:
It generates an "Abnormality Notice" (in substitution of SAC) that complements STM and communicates the incidences in the electrical system. The incidents reported are those that have a significant impact on customers, either by the automatic operation or manual disconnection of a feeder, recloser or switching device, the latter for cases in which the impact is over 1000 customers.
It connects with STM and VINTEG to know and calculate the affected customers. 
The notification will be via email and the recipients are pre-set.

Substitutions:
The purpose of this application is to record a load substitution, indicating the date and reason why the basal scheme of the MV electrical system has been modified to be used in the control centre as an additional to the delivery of the shift, the study unit will also be able to have this information.

It uses public information provided by various administrations that regularly issue avalanche reports informing about the level of hazard, its spatial distribution, and the foreseen avalanche sizes.For all the points that are reachable by avalanches, the release zones of such avalanches are characterized to know their aspects and elevations above the sea level, which will be later compared with those on the avalanche reports.In order to assess whether the avalanche is likely or not to reach the access, each avalanche will be numerically modelized with a specialized software that yields the runout distance of the avalanche according to its size.The tool will determine, according to tailored criteria, whether an access can be used or not and in which conditions, after each new avalanche report release, and will send automatic messages to the concerned staff.

name: Back Office Operation and Settlement
short_description:
Contractual Management
To manage the contracts for the purchase, supply and sale of energy, commodities, derivatives and services associated to the Global Wholesale and Trading unit, executing the related settlement, billing and the claims that might arise; to provide the Global Wholesale and Trading unit with the reporting and analysis on the contracts managed;  to manage the deliveries of CO2 certificates to the competent registries negotiated from Global Wholesale and Trading; to provide main guidelines and promote the optimization and harmonization of credit and business operations processes across all Country units, fostering best practice sharing.
To manage the contracts for the purchase, supply and sale of commodities and services associated to the
Global Fuels, Logistics and Circular Management and Global Gas units, executing the related settlement,
billing and the claims that might arise; to provide the Global Fuels, Logistics and Circular Management and
Global Gas units with the reporting and analysis on the contracts managed;
to provide main guidelines and promote the optimization and harmonization of credit and business operations
processes across all Country units, fostering best practice sharing.

Business Operation:
To manage the metering, settlement and billing processes, determining the income, costs, incentives and energy margin, also for accounting closing purposes of thermal and renewable power plants owned by Enel or delegate by other parties, and in Foreign Countries where a specific ECM unit is not present; to manage the administrative claims that might arise with reference to contracts for purchase, supply and sale of energy, commodities and services associated to the other units within the whole value chain of Energy and Commodity Management in Italy, as well as all their related procedure and their relationships with the counterparts;
To manage the scheduling and the communications related to the power physical deliveries and cross-border power flows in the domestic market, as well as any claims, unbalances and related fees that might occur; to manage the other daily or periodical mandatory communications of operating and financial data to relevant third parties;

name: Capacity Withholding
short_description:
Capacity Withholding controls are designed to ensure that market manipulation through power capacity subtraction is not occurring; they are divided into physical and economic withholding controls.
Physical Withholding controls are designed to ensure that bids for each time unit on the MGP market do not deviate from the capacity available for each individual plant.
It is performed on plants enabled for the MGP (excluding aggregate and virtual consumption units) listed in Enel's database.
Economic Withholding controls are designed to ensure that plants are not offered at artificially high prices, likely to prevent acceptance of their bids. They are performed on plants enabled for the MGP (excluding aggregate and virtual consumption units) listed in Enel's database.

short_description:
ClaudIA is an IIoT-based solution that enables both data acquisition and the execution of distributed artificial intelligence models at the edge (Edge AI). These capabilities support advanced audio analysis and classification, applied as diagnostic and predictive maintenance techniques for wind turbines and other industrial assets.

The platform is designed to be scalable and adaptable to additional O&M use cases. It integrates seamlessly with existing ICT systems, enabling end‑to‑end data flow, interoperability, and alignment with maintenance planning and scheduling tools.

The solution is built on three core components:

-Selection of suitable hardware for edge deployment
-Development of embedded device firmware
-An orchestration layer, including a central controller and a monitoring dashboard

This technological framework is currently deployed in Iberia across two specific use cases:

-Pinbolt: Real-time detection of electromechanical damage inside the nacelle using Edge AI models. Industrialization phase.
-Bladehiss: Detection of surface and structural damage in wind turbine blades. Pilot phase.

In addition, two further use cases (UltraCare and BatHear) are under evaluation and are currently in pre‑PoC design stages to assess feasibility and value prior to PoC launch.

short_description:
The application aim is to offer structured basis for the reporting on climate policy advocacy in the Enel Group's Annual Report and Climate Policy Advocacy Report. 
In particular, to assess the relationship between Enel Group and the related associations, on the topic of climate policy advocacy.

The administrators define the list of associations that are within the assessment scope of the year in the setup functions, then users with different responsibilities perform an assessment through questionnaires for each of the associations under analysis for the current year (campaign).
Following the assessments, the administrators do the final review and the application calculate a final score to each association, supporting the administration in evaluating the association relevance. A structured reporting section also support the data owner in manage and share the assessment results.

The application is related to E-MIA application, considering the similar engagement process of assessment (users engaged with questionnaires or surveys). 
Also, the reporting output can be easily extracted, shared and used in other processes, as for example the Group's Annual Report or Climate Policy Advocacy report production, as already mentioned.

short_description:
Application to manage calls and emails from customers:
The Contact Management module for Endesa Distribución in Salesforce is designed to efficiently manage and optimize interactions with customers and other contacts. Here's a breakdown of its main functions and benefits:

Centralization of Contact Information:

Stores all relevant contact information in one place, including personal data, interaction history, and communication preferences.
Provides quick access to complete and updated information about each contact for all authorized users.
Interaction Management:

Allows for the recording and tracking of all interactions with contacts, such as phone calls and emails
Helps maintain a detailed history of communications, ensuring all interactions are documented and accessible.


Integrates with other Salesforce modules and internal systems at Endesa Distribución, such as billing, claims management, and technical support.
Facilitates a continuous and coherent flow of information, improving coordination between different departments.
Analysis and Reporting:

Provides tools for analysis and reporting to evaluate the effectiveness of interactions with contacts.
Helps identify trends, measure team performance, and make data-driven decisions to improve contact management strategies.
Improvement of Customer Experience:

With a comprehensive and detailed view of each contact, quicker and more personalized responses can be provided to customer inquiries and issues.
Contributes to increased customer satisfaction and the building of stronger, longer-lasting relationships.
In summary, the Contact Management module for Endesa Distribución in Salesforce is designed to centralize contact information, efficiently manage interactions, automate tasks, integrate with other systems, and provide analytical tools, all aimed at improving customer experience and optimizing internal operations.

name: CONTROLLO ACCESSI SELESTA
short_description:
VAM Selesta is an Access control system, a security system that controls who has access to offices. It is a critical component that permits to protect sites and assets from unauthorized access by employees, external persons, vehicles.
The hardware components of a corporate access control system include readers, controllers, and locks. Readers are used to scan or read the credentials of authorized users. Controllers are used to process the data from the readers and authorize or deny access. Locks are used to physically control access to doors and gates. The software components of a corporate access control system are used to manage the system and track access history. This software can be used to create and manage user accounts, set access permissions, and generate reports.
Access control policy 164 define who is authorized to access which areas of a company's premises. These policies should be clearly documented and communicated to all employees. 
These are the main integrated systems:
SAP HR: employee master data, photo (inbound batch); presence clockings (otbound batch)
Service Now: badge management, external persons management (outbound syncronous)

name: DATVAZ
short_description:
IMPORTANTE: Esto no es una aplicación, es solamente un archivo de entrada del modelo DESSEM (modelo de despacho de despacho hidrotermico de curto plazo). Esto ingresa en el horizonte diario y es granularizado por cada media hora. Este archivo de entrada es gestionado directamente por el area de negocio.
Con el fin de facilitar el manejo de los datos y minimizar la posibilidad de errores se han desarrollado dos modelos computacionales auxiliares: 
* DATVAZ : valida información recibida a través de los archivos generados por la ONS y genera el archivo de datos de entrada para los modelos de procesamiento GEVAZP y PREVCEN. 
* PREVCEN: prepara el archivo de flujos incrementales (previsión y escenarios) para el procesamiento en DECOMP. 
Además hay un modelo generador de flujos de entrada multivariable mensual para los modelos Newave y  DECOMP: ese modelo es GEVAZP. 
Este escoge un modelo de serie de tiempo estocástico que asegura la semejanza entre las secuencias de flujos de entrada históricos y generados que puedan producir condiciones de sequía tan severas como aquellas que ocurrieron en el pasado: de hecho se trata de un simulador que hace modelo de reproducción de los escenarios de flujo de caudal basado en el historial de ocurrencia. Gevazp y Datvaz generan archivos de flujo utilizado por PREVCEN para generar el archivo de entrada que se utilizará por DECOMP. Eso contiene: * el flujo previsto en el mes inicial * escenarios de flujos y sus respectivas probabilidades * la configuración del parque hidráulico * la descripción de la estructura de árbol utilizado en el flujo de los escenarios * mes de inicio y año de estudio * los día del segundo mes que se representan en la última semana del mes inicial.

name: DECOMP
short_description:
DECOMP es complementario al Newave. Mientras Newave es un modelo que mira cinco años adelante con una granularidad de meses, DECOMP es un modelo que mira un horizonte de dois meses, com granularidad de semanas. DECOMP es gestionado directamente por el negocio, sin intervanción de Digital Hub Trading.
DECOMP determina el calendario de generación para cada instalación (agua o térmica) que suministra la carga y reducir al mínimo los costos de operación esperados para cada semana durante el primer mes y los meses del período de planificación, teniendo en cuenta el comportamiento estocástico de los flujos de entrada a lo largo de plazo. 
La Planificación Energética, la optimización de las cuencas hidroeléctricas del SIN se lleva a cabo teniendo en cuenta las restricciones eléctricas en el cumplimiento de las cargas. El NEWAVE (definir la función de costo futuro dentro de un horizonte de 5 años) y DECOMP (detalles de la función NEWAVE para el primer mes - límite de 4 meses) se utilizan en la Planificación Energética.

name: E4E I&N SAP ECC (DIP)
short_description:
SAP DIP is the ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system for all Enel Grids distribution companies in Europe (Spain, Italy and Romania). This ERP software enables efficient and integrated management of the company's various internal operations, including purchasing and sales, logistics, plant maintenance, customer service, administration, accounting, finance and economic control.

The SAP DIP system integrates with the following corporate systems:
- Drape for the invoicing of third-party work.
- Webuy for contract tendering.
- OpenPortal/SCM for the commissioning and execution of third party work.
- SWIM/Mare for facility maintenance management.
- MDG for global master data management.
- WB/FB for the accounting of work carried out in the field.
- FOUR/CUATRO for the management of new customer connections.
- AURORA for monitoring large projects on the network.
- NET for the budgeting of works on a cartographic basis
- DEA for resource allocation.

short_description:
SAP DIP is the ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system for all Enel Grids distribution companies in Europe (Spain, Italy and Romania). This ERP software enables efficient and integrated management of the company's various internal operations, including purchasing and sales, logistics, plant maintenance, customer service, administration, accounting, finance and economic control.
It allows you to manage the material tracking process throughout the life cycle of the material from when it is produced from the supplier, to goods receipt on the platform, transfers to secondary warehouses, installation, removal from the plant, transfers between secondary warehouses and platform, the alienation of the material.
Each single step is traced with an object called an event which makes it possible to memorize when who did it took place and which organizational and plant data were involved.
For electronic meters, it allows the entire process of removing the meter from the system to be stored in detail, thus complying with the organizational provisions in force in the country
The Event Management module interfaces with the following applications: mobile TRACE and TOM modules MECE and MEVE; the Smart Tracking Solution; MLM-MSH for the management of deliveries from the Supplier to the Enel Platform, LMS for the management of logistic movements at the Platforms.
Through integration with the Platform, several reporting and analytics solutions have been developed or are under development.

on-demand invalidate a short url

get analytics about the use of a given short url, by chosing among a set of predefined counters or getting a detailed report, to create your own statistics and get the desired insights.

Adempimento degli obblighi contrattuali CONSIP che richiedono il censimento dei dati degli asset installati sui clienti PA, del monitoraggio dei consumi e del controllo dei risparmi ottenuti nell'ambito della fornitura 
Automatizzazione del calcolo in BDP della Co2 risparmiata per consentire di stilare il report annuale sulla sostenibilità in accordo all'algoritmo definito dall'ente certificatore
Reportistica specifica sul portale YoUrban e su CityView
L'obiettivo è di avere una base dati comune e certificata che consenta di poter esporre le informazioni in maniera certificata e coerente nei vari ambiti applicativi sopra delineati.

Planning and Design of public lighting projects for the efficiency of the systems, based on the consumption of the Public Administration evaluated starting from the billing data, from the telemetric measurements and from the plate values of the installed assets
Fulfillment of the CONSIP contractual obligations which require the census of the data of the assets installed on PA customers, the monitoring of consumption and the control of the savings obtained in the context of the supply
Automation of the calculation in BDP of the CO2 saved to allow for the preparation of the annual sustainability report in accordance with the algorithm defined by the certifying body
Specific reporting on the YoUrban portal and on CityView
The goal is to have a common and certified database that allows information to be displayed in a certified and coherent manner in the various application areas outlined above.

short_description:
SCADA System for GAMESA Wind turbines
Gamesa SCADA system = SGIPE and WindNetPro

There are SCADA  systems use to monitor and control remotelly each EGPR power plant (Wind Farm).
It provides real-time data for the field devices (sensors, equipment, ...) related to the wind turbines, power plant controller and meteo station.
It provides all the information generated in the production process (power plant controler, supervision, quality control, production control, data storage, etc.) and allows its management and intervention.

The SCADA system has the following objectives:
- Provide sufficient information in a timely and reliable manner to achieve a safer and more efficient operation, in real time, of EGPR's power plants and of the electrical network close to them.
- Provide a set of network analysis tools that help the Dispatcher in making operational decisions.
- Deliver historical information that allows the analysis and preparation of reports at the internal and external levels, both corporate and regulatory entities.
- Optimize response times to service interruptions in order to comply with or improve the service quality indicators established by the regulatory body
- Comply with legal requirements established by the regulatory body and complying with regulatory requirements.

name: Global Enterprise Service Management - Servicenow
short_description:
ServiceNow is the enterprise platform used to manage and govern the processes related to the products and services currently under contract within the organization. 
It represents the central system of record for operational workflows, service management, compliance, and performance monitoring.

The main implemented modules include ITSM (Incident, Problem, Change, Request and Service Catalog), HRSD for digital HR processes and employee case management, APM for application portfolio governance, PPM for project and demand management, and IRM for integrated risk and compliance management.

In addition to standard out-of-the-box capabilities aligned with industry best practices, the platform hosts several custom applications and tailored developments. 
These custom solutions extend native functionalities, enable integration with external systems, and support specific business requirements not covered by standard modules.

This APM represents the ServiceNow platform as a whole, including its core capabilities and supporting infrastructure, and not the individual applications or modules deployed within it.

short_description:
Aristos is a fully autonomous robotic lawnmower, specifically designed for maintaining the areas around and beneath solar panels in solar farms. The system was developed by the Greek company iKnowHow, based in Athens.
Key Features:
- Precise Navigation:  It uses GNSS signals with RTK corrections, ensuring ±5 cm accuracy. The robot follows a predefined route while avoiding solar panels and sensitive infrastructure.
- Advanced Sensor Integration: It includes the Xsens MTi‑680G all‑in‑one sensor, which combines a GNSS receiver, 3D accelerometer, 3D gyroscope, and magnetometer in a compact and rugged package.
- Obstacle Management: It can self-diagnose the presence of slopes or unmapped obstacles: if the incline exceeds a certain threshold, it stops, alerts the control center, and sends images via an onboard RGB camera for remote monitoring.
- Energy Efficiency: It is designed to maximize battery life: the mowing path is optimized for minimal energy consumption, enabling it to operate repeatedly over time without frequent recharging.

name: IP Tool Hashing EDP Gateway
short_description:
Enel X needs to optimize the management of the IP protection of its platforms and related copyright; traditional IP protection solutions (e.g., SIAE, Bernstein) are suitable for static documents, not for a code that is subject to continuous increases in versions.

The M2M Fuel Switching Application
There are two primary purposes of this application.  First, this application reads the gas meter, categorizes the readings in hourly intervals, stores the reading for up to 30 days, and transmits it nightly for processing into billing data for the utility.  Second, this application allows the utility to control what type of fuel is being used for heating.  The options are natural gas or fuel oil.  At times when natural gas demand is high locations, that utilize the M2M system can be switched to the other fuel.
Key features:
K322 cellular device that reads the gas meter, stores the readings, and controls the fuel being utilized,  The K322 is a low voltage device and it can maintain it memory for up to 30 days without power.
Web interface for the customer to direct the fuel switching and review the meter reads.
Billing data transfer to the utility.  We provide the utility with data on gas usage for billing purposes.
This application is unique.  It was specifically designed for the utility.  The device is specific to their needs and the web interface was created specifically for them.

name: Mantis Chile EDP
short_description:
It's an application that permits the integration and communication with CEN (National Electrical Coordinator), to program the conections and desconections of transmition lines.
Among its main functions:

SIT: Solicitud Interna de Trabajo
It allows the National Electricity Coordinator to be informed of any type of work to be carried out on a transmission line.

SODI: Solicitud Documento Interempresa
If within the SODI it is discovered that the SIT sent previously may interrupt the work of a Coordinate, this request must be sent to inform the CEN and the affected.

SD: Solicitud de Desconexión.
It allows the CEN to be informed of the disconnections that will be carried out, forced or programmed, on a transmitting line.

These processes are regulatory in Chile, and this tool allows them to be automated and made traceable for the Control Room.

name: ME - General Services
short_description:
The application is available on the portal "ME" with the objective to give Enel employees the possibility to open a Service Request asking for a Facility Services, whose category and type can be easily configured. The application is made by different modules specific for each country, in order to have a dedicated governance process according to country's needs.

The final purpose is to support Enel facility management processes with an application structure that ensures governance, traceability and a centralized access point.

name: ME - General Services (Italia)
short_description:
The application module is aimed to enable a group of Service Managers (appropriately configured) belonging to country "Italy" perimeter to handle the Service Request having as Record Producer "Gestione Prestiti Documentali".

These Service Requests are opened in the Portal "WE - Servizi alla Persona" by a PBP in order to ask for the forwarding or scanning of sensitive documentation relating to retired employees.

The above mentioned Service Manager takes in charge and completes (or rejects) the Service Request, informing the PBP of any useful information related to the scope.

The final purpose is to support this sensible process with an application structure that ensures governance, traceability and a centralized access point.

name: ME - General Services (Romania)
short_description:
The application module is available on the portal "ME" with the objective to give romanian employees the possibility to open a Service Request asking for a Facility Service, as for instance air conditioning maintenance service, building maintenance service or cleaning service. 

The Request is taken in charge and completed (or rejected) by a Service Manager appropriately configured. 

The final purpose is to support the romanian facility management process with an application structure that ensures governance, traceability and a centralized access point.

name: ME - General Services (Spagna)
short_description:
The application module is available on the portal "ME" with the objective to give all Enel employees not belonging to country "Spain" the possibility to open a Service Request asking for being enabled to access the sites of Madrid and Barcelona through "ME-Badge" mobile app.  

In reference to the customer journey, any Enel employee not belonging to country "Spain" who opens a Travel request with destination "Madrid" or "Barcelona" receives in the travel notification the possibility to open a Service Request asking for being enabled to access these sites through "ME-Badge" mobile app.

The Service Request is taken in charge and completed (or rejected) by a spanish Service Manager appropriately configured. 

The final purpose is to support the spanish security processes related to Site Access with an application workflow that handles and traces the access request through "ME-Badge" mobile app.

short_description:
Media Planning is a operating tool for the GLOBAL MEDIA area
MP digitizes the management, planning and organization process of the Global Media unit's initiatives.
It allows to track activities on a shared planner
Activities are organized over time, can be categorized, assigned to workgroups, tracked as sensibility and tracked on shared global/country calendars

Application roles
• AUDITORS
• GLOBAL MEDIA ADVANCED
• ADMINISTRATOR

AUDITORS control any action within the portal. They cannot create or edit activities. They have visibility into ALL activities.

GLOBAL MEDIA ADVANCED + ADVANCED COUNTRY users can create and edit tasks. Everyone can see everything
Only if a content is categorized as Price Sensitive, its visibility remains limited to the single country
The Global Media area sees it all

ADMINISTRATORS are administrator users who can operate on the entire portal. They have full permissions
on ALL activities.

name: Meteonorm
short_description:
Meteonorm 8.0 allows access to historical time series of irradiation and temperature. The new archive contains hourly data since 2010 and is constantly updated. You can download these time series directly from the Meteonorm software.

Irradiation data for the globe between 62°S and 62°N are taken from geostationary satellite data. Irradiation data and other parameters outside this area is taken from ERA5 reanalysis data. Temperature profiles are modelled with measured Tmin and Tmax daily data. This allows better reproduction of the daily cycles of the temperature than with ERA 5 data.

The irradiation dataset was compiled combining the Heliosat method applied to the visible channels 1 and 12 (High Resolution Visible) with a multichannel retrieval for snow cover detection using near infrared and infrared channels. short_description:
[12:58] Raffa Gianluca 2 (GECM DH)
The project Short Term Power Price EU has the objective of predicting the fluctuations of energy related short term products (specifically Day-Ahead, Weekend-Ahead and Week-Ahead) in European markets (starting with Germany) for both speculative and hedging purposes. To achieve that, the developed framework makes use of multiple time series analysis using past and future covariates to predict future spot power prices with a horizon of (up to) 13 days. Notably, the predictions are accomplished using StochNet (an Enel-developed library for stochastic analysis with neural networks). 

Both the inputs and the output are handled inside the Data Lake: the former are ingested daily from external info providers, and the latter - results of the predictions - is saved at scheduled time frames during the day.

name: NEWAVE
Newave Brasil
short_description:
The calculation of the spot price of electric energy in the Brazilian market is done by computational models ( such as Newave and Decomp) that use solution techniques that benefit enormously from parallel processing.
Newave is a medium-term hydrothermal optimization model with a horizon of 5 years. This model calculates the operating policy that serves as input for the DECOMP model, which, in turn, is a complementary model with a horizon of 2 months, which calculates the weekly PLD. Enel runs these 2 models in the virtual machine environment with parallel processing on Amazon Public Cloud. Newave is managed directly by the business, it is not under the management of Digital Hub Trading, since it is very specific and is outside Enel's Infrastructure.
It is used to generate price forecasts. Is is an official program used by all energy companies in Brazil. It is Executed weekly to reproduce the prices that will be generated by the National System Operator.
Future vision;
5 year forecast

OILWEB is a software application used by Enel Green Power & TGX DRILLING unit to manage the consumption, traceability, and fiscal reporting of diesel fuel employed in geothermal drilling activities.
The application supports the recording and monitoring of fuel loading, unloading, stock levels, and consumption associated with generator sets used in drilling sites. It enables the correlation between fuel usage and energy production, ensuring accurate and auditable data management.
OILWEB ensures compliance with national regulations concerning excise duties and fiscal reporting obligations, including required communications to the relevant authorities. It reduces the risk of non-compliance and associated penalties by providing complete traceability and structured data handling.
The application is delivered as a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solution, including continuous updates, technical support, and maintenance services. It represents a critical system supporting a core business process, ensuring operational continuity and regulatory adherence for geothermal drilling activities

name: OT-EGP&TGX-SCADA
short_description:
SCADA installed in Renewable Plants (Wind, Solar, Bess, Thermo, Hydro).
SCADA is a flexible solution for field data acquisition, to visualize plant status and perform efficient remote control. It provides highly scalable modular architecture, with high-capacity database supporting more than 1.000.000 system tags organized in geographically distributed hierarchical multilayers. Natively integrates advanced redundancy management features with both central system elements and field devices (RTU) configurable in redundant hot-backup configuration, to ensure the maximum level of availability and integrity of data. It allows to interface third parties RTUs and devices via standard protocols like IEC 870.5.101-104, IEC 61850, MODBUS, OPC, and many others, granting high compatibility and interoperability. The architecture integrates highly flexible HMI (Human-Machine Interface) features that can be deployed on local operator stations or remotely via Web, enabling single monitor to high resolution videowall visualization. The solution also include Engineering Station configuration software to adapt HMI characteristics both to medium-sized plants and complex, large scale solutions.

name: PLANT SCADA HYDRO ELIPSE AGROTRAFO BRAZIL
short_description:
Plant SCADA System for Electrical Hydro Agrotrafo Plant (Elipse).

SCADA, an acronym for Supervisory Control And Data Acquisition, is a computer software for remote control and monitoring of industrial processes. It provides real-time feedback to field devices (sensors and actuators), and controls the process automatically.
It provides all the information generated in the production process (supervision, quality control, production control, data storage, etc.) and allows its management and intervention.

The SCADA Project has the following objectives:
- Provide sufficient information in a timely and reliable manner to achieve a safer and more efficient operation, in real time, of ENEL's power plants and of the electrical network close to them.
- Provide a set of network analysis tools that help the Dispatcher in making operational decisions.
- Deliver historical information that allows the analysis and preparation of reports at the internal and external levels, both corporate and regulatory entities.
- Optimize response times to service interruptions in order to comply with or improve the service quality indicators established by the regulatory body
- Comply with legal requirements established by the regulatory body and complying with regulatory requirements.

This is a proof of concept to check the capabilities of DigitelTS to provide an end-to-end and autonomous contracting process. Steps are: 
1.-Collection by ENDESA of the client's consent to be contacted by WhatsApp (OPT-IN WSA), either by Web, Telephone, etc...
2. Sending outbound notification by WSA (HSM).
3. The client receives the WhatsApp message and its contractual documentation.
4. You are asked if you have received and reviewed it. With the positive answer we close the provision and acceptance of the conditions.
5. In the next step, the "consent" of the client to carry out the contract is collected.
6. We electronically sign the contractual documentation and deliver it now formalize the client.
7. Finally, we generate a unique electronic certificate that includes all the evidence electronic and includes electronically signed contracts. which we put available to our client and we guard for 5 years.

short_description:
Portale Internet E-Distribuzione (PED) is a web portal exposed on the internet as a Salesforce Community, and it aims to offer a list of services to registered users who are customers of E-Distribuzione.
The main services made available by PED for customers who have at least one supply connected to the E-Distribuzione grid are:
- consultation of readings and load curves of the PODs
- tracking of practices opened to E-Distribuzione
- alert notifications for scheduled works or outages on the PODs by means of the E-Notify system (AP04885)
- e-payment of invoices and quotes associated to the PODs
Data managed by PED consists of contact registries of the customers which are registered on the portal, meanwhile other information used in the above services are retrieved through integrations with other Enel systems.
PED shares the infrastructure and the front-end with Portale Produttori (Module IT04281.08), which is another Salesforce Community offering services to E-Distribuzione customers registered on the Portal which are also energy producers.
Finally, the main functionalities of PED are also replicated in a Mobile Application (Module IT04281.01)

name: Quality Monitoring DIRECT
short_description:
Direct is a tool that allows you to record and listen to samples of telephone calls arriving to toll-free numbers and evaluate their management. These assessments are considered strategic both for directing marketing and customer caring policies on Enel customers and for monitoring the quality provided by external partners.

The technology used is the Quality Monitoring system, called DirectTM, customized for Enel, which, with its application modules, allows:

• audio recording and profiled playback of calls arriving to toll-free numbers (inbound),
• audio recording and profiled playback of telephone calls originating from telephone Consultants (outbound),
• the qualitative evaluation of the recorded material according to structured processes involving around 2,000 users,
• Speech Analytics and Trend Topics: analysis of recordings through speech recognition and analysis technologies,
• the availability of conversations for the purposes of regulatory or judicial checks,
• the qualitative assessment of chat conversations that take place on web portals,
• verification of commercial compliance through automatic verification of Vocal Orders made on the Free Market,
• the qualitative assessment of the document processing carried out by the back office sectors,
• sample recording and playback for qualitative purposes of end-to-end phone calls including the audio interaction between the caller and the Vocal Virtual Assistant.

name: SAGE Enel D Work
short_description:
ENEL D Work is a mobile application designed to optimize the management and monitoring of work carried out by crews in the field. This tool facilitates the control of field work carried out by ENEL or Contractor crews.
Features:
Job Management: Start and detail of jobs, selecting workers accredited in SAGE (the main Web Application) according to ENEL criteria. Record of safety talks and execution of checklists adapted to the type of task performed.
Registration and Monitoring: Document the participation of workers and supervisors through simple digital signatures. During execution, it allows you to carry out inspections, report incidents, Safety Observations, Safety Walk and Stop Works.
Communications and News: Keeps the crew informed, with updated communications and management of news within the crew.
Closing and Documenting Jobs: At the end of the jobs, it allows you to close the tasks and save digital evidence of the completed work.
Integration with SAGE: All the information collected is synchronized with the crews module in SAGE, allowing exhaustive consultation and analysis of the data.

name: SAGE Enel G Work
short_description:
ENEL G Work is a mobile application designed to optimize the management and monitoring of work carried out by crews in the field and field inspection. This tool facilitates the control of field work carried out by ENEL crews or Contractors.
Features:
Field review: review information on the accreditation status of workers and vehicles within ENEL facilities and report deviations.
Job Management: Initiate and detail jobs, selecting SAGE-accredited workers according to ENEL criteria. Record safety talks and execute checklists adapted to the type of task performed.
Recording and Tracking: Document worker and supervisor participation using simple digital signatures. During execution, carry out Asbestos removal inspections which follow the entire process required for the management of this type of material.
Closing and Documenting Jobs: Upon completion of jobs, close tasks and save digital evidence of completed work.
Integration with SAGE: All the information collected is synchronized with the crews module in SAGE, allowing data consultation.

name: SAGE Enel X Work
short_description:
ENEL X Work is a mobile application designed to optimize the management and monitoring of work carried out by field works. This tool facilitates the control of field work carried out by Contractor works.
 
Features:
 
Job Management: Start and detail of jobs, selecting workers accredited in SAGE (the Main Web Application) according to ENEL criteria, in type works: Traditional, Daily Work, AP Maintenance or AP Replacement. Record of safety talks and execution of checklists adapted to the type of task performed.
Registration and Monitoring: Document the participation of workers and supervisors through simple digital signatures. During execution, it allows you to carry out Inspections, Incident reporting, Stop Works, Five golden rules, Delivery and return of work area or complex activities and Authorization for pits.
Closing and Documenting Jobs: At the end of the jobs, it allows you to close the tasks and save digital evidence of the completed work.
Integration with SAGE: All the information collected is synchronized with the Works module in SAGE, allowing exhaustive consultation and analysis of the data.

name: SAGE Entrance
short_description:
Mobile application for access control of workers and vehicles of contractors and subcontractors, which comply with ENEL accreditation standards, allowing access to the interior of projects or parks (facilities) once their accreditation has been verified. This application records both the entry and exit of workers and vehicles using an integrated QR reader or the device's camera. This QR reader or camera scans the code present on the credential generated by the platform. Reading these codes automatically sends entry and exit information to our database, which can be consulted at any time through the SAGE platform.

Among the main features of this application are:

- Access control of people and vehicles in both facilities, through QR code verification of physical credentials.
- Offline operation after synchronizing data.
- Compatibility with devices with 2D barcode readers for greater integration.

 Deliver historical information that allows the analysis and preparation of reports at the internal and external levels, both corporate and regulatory entities.

It provides all the information generated in the production process (supervision, quality control, production control, data storage, etc.) and allows its management and intervention.

The SCADA Project has the following objectives:
- Provide sufficient information in a timely and reliable manner to achieve a safer and more efficient operation, in real time, of ENEL's power plants and of the electrical network close to them.
- Provide a set of network analysis tools that help the Dispatcher in making operational decisions.
- Deliver historical information that allows the analysis and preparation of reports at the internal and external levels, both corporate and regulatory entities.
- Optimize response times to service interruptions in order to comply with or improve the service quality indicators established by the regulatory body
- Comply with legal requirements established by the regulatory body and complying with regulatory requirements.

Enel Distribución debido a la naturaleza de los servicios de distribución de energía en la región Metropolitana dispone de diversa infraestructura para garantizar sus operaciones técnicas de Alta, Media y baja tensión. name: SensorAPP_Gridspertise
short_description:
The purpose of the developments associated with this APM is the industrialisation of advanced sensing and business logic in secondary substations.  
These developments are needed because the current application (developed with the PoC2020 and the previous PoC100) of advanced sensoristics was designed for the LVM concentrator and hence not taking into account the new possibilities that QED and Edge computing bring. 
The idea is to make the data from advanced sensing available to the various Apps containing business logic that are on board of the QED. In this way, it is then possible to combine these data with telecontrol and remote management data, gaining valuable knowledge from the system and allowing an appropriate reaction with near-zero latencies directly in the field (next to the devices). These new developments also aim to increase the level of security using the Zero Trust Security and DevSecOps paradigms, together with storing private keys within the device's anti-tampering hardware. The final goal with respect to security is to adhere to the strictest international security standards. 
In conclusion, will be able to safeguard the safety of equipments and people, helping to achieve various goals, including the ambitious 'Zero Accident' goal. The Platform Solution, following the paradigm of Platform Expansion, and, more specifically, the principle of "write once run anywhere," will have the edge environment as a deployment target, implementing the functionality of the Platform Nervous System to exchange data towards the field (devices or apps on QEd) and towards the centre (Data Domains). Via the sensor app, in fact, the sensor data passing through the merging-units are published in the form of events within one or more topics of the local event bus. In such manner, the data are made available to any software component interested and authorised to consume this data (subscriber) in near real time.

The claims module for Endesa Distribución in Salesforce is designed to manage and resolve customer claims efficiently. Here's a breakdown of its main functions and benefits:

Claims Management:

Allows for the registration, tracking, and resolution of customer claims in a structured manner.
Facilitates tracking each claim from its initiation to resolution, ensuring no claim is lost or left unattended.
Centralization of Information:

Consolidates all information related to a claim in one place, including customer data, problem details, communications, and actions taken.
Improves accessibility and visibility of information for all involved teams.
Process Automation:

Automates repetitive tasks and notifications, reducing response times and improving operational efficiency.
Uses predefined workflows to ensure all claims are managed according to company policies.
Analysis and Reporting:

Provides tools for analysis and reporting to evaluate the performance of the customer service team and the effectiveness of claim resolutions.
Helps identify trends and areas for improvement, as well as measure customer satisfaction.
Integration with Other Systems:

Integrates with other modules and systems within Endesa Distribución, such as billing, technical services, and customer management, facilitating a continuous and coherent flow of information.
Helps coordinate actions between different departments for quicker and more effective resolution.
Improvement of Customer Experience:

By having an organized and efficient system for managing claims, it improves the customer experience, reducing wait times and increasing overall satisfaction.
Allows customers to receive updates on the status of their claims more quickly and accurately.
In summary, the claims module for Endesa Distribución in Salesforce is designed to enhance the efficiency of claims management, centralize information, automate processes, and provide analytical tools, all with the aim of improving customer satisfaction and optimizing internal operations.

name: SMAP
short_description:
Este modelo todavía no es utilizado. Sin embargo, va a ser gestionado directamente por el negocio en la nube pública de Amazon. No va a ser gestionado por Digital Hub Trading. 
El modelo SMAP (Humedad del Suelo Procedimiento de Contabilidad) fue desarrollado en 1981 por Lopes, JEG, Braga, BPF y Conejo, JGL, presentado en el Simposio Internacional sobre Modelización lluvia-escorrentía - Mississippi, EE.UU. y publicado por Water Resourses Publicaciones (LOPES et al 1982). El modelo es el tipo determinista, conceptual, concentrado, de transformación de tipo lluvia-escorrentía. 
La aplicación del modelo para la cuenca del Río Grande permite la elaboración de la previsión de flujo natural, con el horizonte de hasta 12 días por delante mediante el modelo ETA previsión de lluvia, durante 10 días y se verifica la información de la lluvia y el flujo de las estaciones hidrométricas existente en la cuenca. El pronóstico de precipitación obtenida del modelo de ETA ha sido identificado por algunos sub-cuencas y durante algunos períodos del año, una tendencia de sobreestimación de los valores previstos a lo observado. 
Utiliza como motor de cálculo Scilab, software freeware.

name: Virtual_UP
short_description:
App Virtual UP installed on QED. 
 This app implements the secondary substation device UP (also named RTU), a device able to communicate with the SCADA in order to exchange field information such as measurements and faults and to apply automation. In this way, a DSO can substitute the physical UPs with the virtualized ones avaible on the QED and provided by this app. The application is installed through EdgeBeat, and can exchange data with the SCADA and the other QED components. The app is not accessible remotely. Its main features are related to the possibility to perform automations: in particular, when a fault detector detects a fault or an outage, the virtual UP can act according to the automation logics decided by the SCADA. Combining the virtual UP with the Soltuion GAM, these logics can be automated and applied in a distributed manner, without the need of a central SCADA as an orchestrator. The automation logic has the effect of isolating the fault and of limiting the consequent damages.The The idea is to provide customers with an ecosystem capable of bringing new functionality and intelligence into the field, through the Edge and in particular through the Quantum Edge Device, in continuity with the cloud. By having computing power and logic capabilities on board the QED, using data from advanced sensors, remote control and remote management, combining them it will be possible to acquire knowledge and react with near zero latency directly in the field.
App on Edge (QED, smartphone, smart meters).

For remotes that don't implement the file transfer function, a subset of the information is obtained from CMD IBERIA DISTRIBUCION historical repository.

Users access the data and reports by web, or they received it by email notification if the user is subscribed to the affected equipment.

name: Worked Hours
short_description: The solution aims to develop a global system for the recovery of hours worked by contracting companies at Enel Green Power industrial sites through the collection of timestamps from access control systems. This system will aim to centralize and simplify the process of collecting and managing access data, improving operational efficiency and providing a clear and accurate view of access to industrial sites. A key element of this system will be its ability to track the hours worked by contractor personnel via integration with access control systems across all EGP's countries. This data will be used to calculate the incident frequency rate (IFR), a key indicator of workplace safety, which will allow proactive monitoring and management of safety risks, contributing to creating a safer work environment.
